title: DO AS I SAY, NOT AS I DO: INSTRUCTION-INDUCTION CONFLICT IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the structural conflict between instruction-following and in-context pattern induction in LLMs. While it uses 'value-aligned' prompts (e.g., related to helpfulness) to probe model priors, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks as a primary research component.
